name: PostHog
description: PostHog is a product analytics and product-engineering platform for Events, Insights, Dashboards, Funnels, Retention, Feature Flags, Experiments, Session Replay, Surveys, Error Tracking, LLM Analytics, Data Warehouse, and customer data workflows.
agentUseSummary: Connect through Relay's PostHog CIMD OAuth client with PKCE and seven exact read scopes, then bind one US/EU Cloud Organization and Project. Relay exposes seven curated wrappers for bounded Projects, redacted Dashboards and Insights, one approval-gated 31-day Event Trend, and redacted Event/Property schema; persons, recordings, raw data, arbitrary HogQL, broader products, exports, raw MCP, and every write remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: RELAY_POSTHOG_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_URL
credentialRequirements.label: Relay PostHog CIMD URL
credentialRequirements.helpText: Railway must contain the approved HTTPS Relay Client ID Metadata Document URL. The document identifies Relay and lists the exact Railway callback.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTHOG_API_ORIGIN
credentialRequirements.label: PostHog Cloud API origin
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select https://us.posthog.com or https://eu.posthog.com for the exact granted Project. Self-hosted and arbitrary origins are outside V1.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTHOG_ORGANIZATION_ID
credentialRequirements.label: PostHog Organization ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select the exact Organization authorized by the OAuth grant.

credentialRequirements.name: POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: PostHog Project/Environment ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Select the exact numeric Project/Environment ID used by every Relay data tool.

capabilities.label: Bounded Event trend
capabilities.description: Run one fixed short daily Event-total Trend.

capabilities.label: Analytics schema
capabilities.description: Read bounded Event and Property Definition summaries.

allowed.label: List Projects
allowed.description: List at most 25 Project/Environment summaries for the exact Organization and identify the selected Project.

allowed.label: List Dashboards
allowed.description: List at most 25 redacted Dashboard summaries for the selected Project.

allowed.label: Read Dashboard
allowed.description: Read one redacted Dashboard summary without tiles, Insight results, filters, or sharing configuration.

allowed.label: List Insights
allowed.description: List at most 25 redacted Insight summaries for the selected Project.

allowed.label: Read Insight
allowed.description: Read one redacted Insight summary without query filters, results, persons, or raw Event data.

allowed.label: Read analytics schema
allowed.description: List at most 25 redacted Event or Property Definition summaries for the selected Project.

approvalRequired.label: Run bounded Event trend
approvalRequired.description: Run one fixed daily total Trend for one exact Event over an explicit range of at most 31 days.

blocked.label: Access persons or recordings
blocked.description: Person/Group records, distinct IDs, properties, cohorts and membership, session recordings, replays, traces, logs, support conversations, and classified data are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access raw analytics data
blocked.description: Raw Events, properties/values, arbitrary HogQL/SQL, arbitrary queries, broad exports, Data Warehouse, detailed filters, and unbounded results are outside V1.

blocked.label: Change PostHog data
blocked.description: Event capture and every Dashboard, Insight, Feature Flag, Experiment, Cohort, Annotation, Survey, Notebook, Pipeline, Subscription, Organization, Project, or other mutation are outside V1.

blocked.label: Access broader PostHog products
blocked.description: Feature Flags, Experiments, Session Replay, Error Tracking, Surveys, LLM Analytics, Revenue Analytics, Data Warehouse, CDP, Support, and administrative products are outside V1.

blocked.label: Use raw PostHog MCP or API
blocked.description: Raw hosted MCP tools, arbitrary origins/Organizations/Projects/paths/queries, pagination, crawling, synchronization, and raw REST access are outside V1.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Six bounded metadata/schema reads run automatically; the fixed Event trend requires approval, while persons, raw data, broader products, arbitrary access, MCP, exports, and writes stay blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All seven curated read-only tools run without Relay per-action approval while exact region/Organization/Project binding, fixed requests, short ranges, audit, redaction, and provider limits remain enforced.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts seven curated PostHog REST wrappers and attaches refreshed OAuth access server-side after exact Cloud-region, Organization, and Project binding.
Railway mounts seven curated PostHog REST wrappers and attaches refreshed OAuth access server-side after exact Cloud-region, Organization, and Project binding.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's approved HTTPS PostHog Client ID Metadata Document is not yet published or configured in Railway, and no real US/EU Cloud user grant is available for consent and live semantic acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: Publish the approved Relay CIMD document with the exact Railway callback, set RELAY_POSTHOG_OAUTH_CLIENT_METADATA_URL on Railway, then complete US/EU Cloud consent, refresh/revocation, Project binding, seven bounded reads, Safe approval, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial checks.

evidence.supports: PostHog documents region-agnostic OAuth, URL-valued CIMD client identity, exact redirect metadata, authorization-code and refresh grants, PKCE S256, optional verification, bearer-header tokens, and access/refresh token types.
PostHog's live authorization metadata publishes the authorization, token, revocation, userinfo, supported read scopes, refresh grant, public-client token authentication, and S256 PKCE capability.
PostHog documents Organization-scoped Project reads, project:read, bounded list parameters, bearer authentication, and the private fields Relay strips.
PostHog documents Project-scoped Dashboard list/detail endpoints and dashboard:read authority.
PostHog documents Project-scoped Insight list/detail endpoints and insight:read authority.
PostHog documents Project-scoped query execution and query:read; Relay permits only one fixed short daily EventsNode TrendsQuery.
PostHog documents bounded Event Definition reads and event_definition:read.
PostHog documents bounded Property Definition reads and property_definition:read.
